name: io.datanika/datanika-mcp
description: Read-only-by-default MCP for Datanika: browse data, run dbt transforms, manage ELT pipelines.

environmentVariables.name: DATANIKA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Datanika instance URL (defaults to https://app.datanika.io; set this for a self-hosted instance)

environmentVariables.name: DATANIKA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Datanika API key (from Settings -> API Keys)

environmentVariables.name: DATANIKA_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable write/trigger tools (read-only by default)
